import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'Person ID': [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    'Gender': ['Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male'],
    'Age': [27, 28, 28, 28, 28],
    'Occupation': ['Software Engineer', 'Doctor', 'Doctor', 'Sales Representative', 'Sales Representative'],
    'Sleep Duration': [6.1, 6.2, 6.2, 5.9, 5.9],
    'Quality of Sleep': [6, 6, 6, 4, 4],
    'Physical Activity Level': [42, 60, 60, 30, 30],
    'Stress Level': [6, 8, 8, 8, 8],
    'BMI Category': ['Overweight', 'Normal', 'Normal', 'Obese', 'Obese'],
    'Blood Pressure': ['126/83', '125/80', '125/80', '140/90', '140/90'],
    'Heart Rate': [77, 75, 75, 85, 85],
    'Daily Steps': [4200, 10000, 10000, 3000, 3000],
    'Sleep Disorder': ['', '', '', 'Sleep Apnea', 'Sleep Apnea']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Parse blood pressure into systolic and diastolic
df[['Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = [16, 10]
plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 10

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(constrained_layout=True)

# Create grid for subplots
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 4)

# 1. Sleep metrics by occupation (top left)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0:2])
sleep_metrics = df.groupby('Occupation')[['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep']].mean()
sleep_metrics.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#1f77b4', '#ff7f0e'])
ax1.set_title('Sleep Metrics by Occupation', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Score')
ax1.legend(['Sleep Duration (hrs)', 'Quality of Sleep (1-10)'])
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Physical activity vs daily steps (top right)
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2:])
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Daily Steps'], 
                      c=df['Stress Level'], s=150, cmap='Reds', alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
ax2.set_ylabel('Daily Steps')
ax2.set_title('Physical Activity vs Daily Steps (colored by Stress Level)', fontweight='bold')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2, label='Stress Level')

# 3. BMI distribution (middle left)
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
colors = ['#2ca02c', '#d62728', '#ff7f0e']
ax3.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontweight='bold')

# 4. Heart rate by occupation (middle right)
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
bp_data = df.groupby('Occupation')[['Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']].mean()
bp_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#e377c2', '#17becf'])
ax4.set_title('Blood Pressure by Occupation', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Blood Pressure (mmHg)')
ax4.legend(['Systolic', 'Diastolic'])
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 5. Health metrics correlation heatmap (bottom left)
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2:])
corr_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
             'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps', 'Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']
corr_matrix = df[corr_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_matrix, dtype=bool))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, square=True, linewidths=1, ax=ax5, cbar_kws={'label': 'Correlation'})
ax5.set_title('Health Metrics Correlation Matrix', fontweight='bold')

# 6. Sleep disorder presence (bottom right)
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
sleep_disorder_data = df[df['Sleep Disorder'] != '']
if not sleep_disorder_data.empty:
    disorder_counts = sleep_disorder_data['Occupation'].value_counts()
    ax6.bar(disorder_counts.index, disorder_counts.values, color='#9467bd')
    ax6.set_title('Sleep Disorder Cases by Occupation', fontweight='bold')
    ax6.set_ylabel('Number of Cases')
    ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
else:
    ax6.text(0.5, 0.5, 'No Sleep Disorder Cases', ha='center', va='center', 
             fontsize=12, transform=ax6.transAxes)
    ax6.set_title('Sleep Disorder Cases by Occupation', fontweight='bold')

# Add overall title
plt.suptitle('Health and Sleep Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
